title: Johnson Evinrude 317001 - Coil Locating Ring Tool
author: Im_Mike_D
description:
3D printed version of the Johnson Evinrude part number 317001 coil locating ring.

This part is used on various johnson/evinrude outboard motors from the late 1950's including the sea-horse 7.5hp motor. Model numbers I know for sure it fits are AD-11 and ADL-11.

The tool is used to align the gap on the armature ignition coils so they don't contact the flywheel.

I printed this up in about 45 minutes and it worked perfectly. I have a nice clean spark on both cylinders.

It's about the simplest 3D print possible… It's just a ring with a 4.47 inch inner diameter.

johnson evinrude ignition coil outboard motor vintage motor repair
